lines: Class one. Sit. Or stand, you have no chairs.
Today: rocks. Every rock here started as melted stone.
Melted stone that cools slowly grows big crystals.
Cooled fast, at the surface: tiny crystals, or none.
Glass, even. Look through the hand lens and you will see.
There are rocks lying about outside.
Pick them up. Test them. Use the key in your notebook.

task.text: Identify two different rocks in the lab.

lines: Class two. You have been outside. Good.
A survey is not a walk. It is a walk with a map.
Your map has letters across and numbers down.
A letter and a number name one square: C3, say.
Write where things are, not just what they are.
Three things outside, noticed and written down.
That is your task. Water counts. Stones count.

task.text: Look closely at three things and write them in the notebook.

lines: Class three. People.
They are the hardest part of any planet.
Nobody here owes you anything. Say hello anyway.
Come back tomorrow and say it again.
When they know you, they will tell you what maps cannot.
Learn one true thing from a person in this town.
Not from a sign. From a person.

task.text: Learn one thing from a person in town.

lines: Class four. Your map still has blank squares.
Blank squares are where surveys go to die.
The compass on your map points north.
North is the top of the map. Always, on this planet.
Walk the edges. Fill the blanks.
A third of the map, at least, before your final report.
And the final report is due at the end of day 90.

task.text: Explore at least a third of the map.

lines.classToday: Day {day}. You have class today. Come to the ship. On time.
lines.classMissed: You missed class yesterday. Here are my notes. Read them.
lines.taskGrace: Day {day}. Your task was due. Are you all right? One more chance: day {due}.
lines.taskMissed: Day {day}. Task not done: {task} It goes on your record.
lines.deadlineSoon: Reminder: final report at the end of day {due}. {left} day(s) left.
finalPass: That is a pass. You may stay as long as you like.
The next class begins when the term does.
finalFail: That is below the pass mark. You will retake the class.
Everything you have found stays. No more classes. Go and look.
retakePass: Passed. Took you a while. It took me longer, once.
